reviews.comment: I have been wearing these chunky hoops non-stop for 3 weeks, including gym sessions and daily showers! Not a single sign of fading or tarnishing. Truly premium quality and super lightweight on the ears.
The packaging was so luxurious with the velvet pouch and care card! Fast delivery to Lahore in 2 days. 100% recommended for everyone who loves tarnish-free gold pieces.
The pearl looks even prettier in person! It has a gorgeous natural sheen and the gold chain has that warm 18k hue without looking cheap. Placed a second order for my sister.
Wore this to a wedding reception and received so many compliments! The double clasp is very secure and the zircon stones shine just like real diamonds. Incredible craftsmanship.
